summary: Eight-band parametric EQ, minimum phase and zero latency: bell, low and high shelf, low and high cut at 12/24/48 dB/oct, notch; frequency in Hz, gain in 0.1 dB steps, Q. Bands 2–7 start on at 0 dB (transparent until a gain is set); the cuts, bands 1 and 8, start off. Use it for precise, labelled moves such as "B3: Bell, 320 Hz, −3 dB, Q 1.4".

parameters.name: B1 on
parameters.description: Band 1 in or out (an off band passes the signal untouched)

parameters.name: B1 type
parameters.description: Band 1: bell, shelves (half the gain at the frequency), Butterworth cuts (−3 dB at the frequency with Q 0.71), notch

parameters.name: B1 freq
parameters.description: Band 1 frequency: centre, shelf midpoint or cutoff

parameters.name: B1 gain
parameters.description: Band 1 gain in 0.1 dB steps (bells and shelves)

parameters.name: B1 Q
parameters.description: Band 1 Q: bell and notch width, shelf and cut resonance (0.71 is flat)

parameters.name: B1 slope
parameters.description: Band 1 slope (low and high cut)
